ops.title: ccx alias fix covers name matching only — payload lowering still open
ops.body:
v10.3.0's MCP_TOOL_ALIASES fixes NAME matching only: parse_tool_call still lowers mcp__cc-context__ccx_code_edit to OtherCall, so capt-hook evt.file/evt.content/evt.replaced are None and diff-gated conditions (LongCommentIntroduced) never fire on ccx edits despite the Tool() gate matching.

Design options analyzed 2026-07-10:
(a) cc-transcript typed CcxEditCall/CcxReplaceCall in TOOL_TYPES — the clean home, but the ToolCall hierarchy is mid-rework on platform-2.0; coordinate before landing on main.
(b) capt-hook-side adapter in events.py content/replaced with a disk pre-image at PreToolUse — precedent: WriteCall's disk_pre_image; ccx payload is {file, at: 'A-B#hash', content}; the span pre-image is readable from disk at PreToolUse via the at-range.

Tracked as backlog task f6a1492.
